title: ClockInToday No-Interview Jobs Dataset
description:
Requirements and pay terms for 112 US jobs and gig platforms you can start without a job interview: delivery and rideshare apps, shift and staffing apps, online work, surveys and rewards, plasma donation and paid studies.

For each platform: minimum age, whether a criminal background check is run, vehicle needed, payout speed, reported pay (with its source), worker type (W-2 or contractor), and a link to the full sourced listing. Values come from each company's own pages and are rechecked monthly.

Methodology: https://clockintoday.com/how-we-check/ . Report with charts: https://clockintoday.com/report/
